mapper.select: SELECT a.tag_id, a.tag_name, a.address, a.alarm_msg, a.level, l.id AS lamp_id, a.alarm_msg_eng, a.alarm_desc, a.pdf_file, a.pdf_name, a.img_file, a.img_name FROM ez_scada.tb_alarm_tag a LEFT JOIN ez_scada.folders_tags l ON l.folder_id = 6 AND l.name = CONCAT(a.tag_name, '_lamp') WHERE a.folder_id = 54 AND a.enabled = 1 ORDER BY a.tag_id
